title: Bakugan Totems
description: Childhood atmosphere in your inventory! Changes the textures of totems to Bakugan when renamed.
body:
# Bakugan Totems

## 🔥 What is it?

Tired of the same old totem of immortality? This resource pack transforms the default totem into epic, fully customized 3D models inspired by the iconic Bakugan from the beloved anime series! Simply rename your totem on an anvil to any of the listed Bakugan names, and watch it come to life with a unique model. The totem’s activation sound has also been revamped to match the Bakugan theme, making every use feel legendary!

To get these totems, you need to rename them to the names that will be presented below:

## ✅ Currently Added Bakugan
